classes.beneficial: Gives, preserves or releases something for its subject, finds against nobody, and asks of anybody else only what they already owe.
classes.adverse: Restricts, takes, confines, compels or finds against a person, an animal's custodian, an association or a private actor, or permits harm to an animal.
classes.power-over-others: Confers a public power, office, representative or decision role that other people must answer to.
classes.oversight: Finds a public act defective or unsupported, certifies that a public body failed to act, or corrects or ends a public power.
classes.institutional: Configures a public institution, record or process without deciding anything for or against an individual subject.

reasons.competence: Allocates or exercises a tier's or body's jurisdiction.
reasons.lawmaking: Makes, funds or executes law that binds others.
reasons.office: Selects, appoints, seats or replaces an office-holder or public body.
reasons.election: Certifies or configures an electoral, collective or institutional result.
reasons.local: Protected local control over a local budget, administration, space, facility or service.
reasons.court-relief: Case relief for a person that finds a public or coercive act unlawful.
reasons.invalidation: Invalidates or reviews a law or procedure.
reasons.removal: Removes or rejects a person from an office or candidacy.
reasons.political-home: Determines or transfers where a person votes.
reasons.restricts-private: Restricts, takes from, or compels a private actor or enterprise.
reasons.fiscal: Raises, appropriates, spends, borrows or regulates money or payment.
reasons.scarcity: Declares scarcity or allocates what is short, so some claims go unmet.
reasons.shortfall: Records an unmet claim, which obliges repair without finding against anyone.
reasons.carry-benefit: Carries an existing benefit, title or liability into the current constitutional record; it reconciles records rather than deciding anything.
reasons.coercive-order: An individual coercive order or measure against a person.
reasons.mandate: Confers a protective mandate on a public function.
reasons.emergency: Declares, renews or acts under an emergency or armed-response power.
reasons.external: Treaty, trade, defence structure or exit settlement, deciding nothing for an individual.
reasons.defect: Finds a public act or record defective, unsupported or ended.
reasons.nonresponse: Certifies that a public body did not respond, moving its duty to an alternate.
reasons.holding-found: Finds that a person is held, which obliges care, voice and review for them.
reasons.disclosure-protected: Protects a person who disclosed wrongdoing.
reasons.force-found: Finds force necessary, which permits harm.
reasons.access: Gives a person access, assistance, a hearing, an appeal or continuity.
reasons.remedy: Gives a remedy or relief to the person harmed.
reasons.binding-remedy: A remedy, reparation or relief that binds the party found responsible.
reasons.title: Determines protected title, which binds competing claimants.
reasons.charging: Charges, investigates or enforces against a person.
reasons.record-holding: Holds, processes, retains or uses records about people.
reasons.own-record: Gives a person access to or correction of their own record.
reasons.statistics-release: Releases or rebuts aggregate statistics with no individual subject.
reasons.presumption: Raises a presumption against a public body in an equality proceeding.
reasons.amendment: Certifies, publishes or selects a constitutional version.
reasons.accommodation: An accommodation for the person who needs it.
reasons.positive-measure: A positive measure that allocates chances between people.
reasons.equality-proceeding: A remedial equality proceeding against a respondent.
reasons.determination: Determines a claim whose outcome can go against the claimant.
reasons.collective-effect: Permits an effect on a collective or its land without its consent.
reasons.collective-consent: Records a collective's own consent, consultation or finding.
reasons.cultural: Protects a collective's culture or title.
reasons.self-government: Confers governing or representative authority within a collective.
reasons.integrity-finding: Finds against an office-holder, candidate, association or coordinated actor.
reasons.opposition: Records a member's opposition, which gives them opposition rights.
reasons.cross-domain: Resolves a conflict between protected claims, so one side yields.
reasons.knowledge-restriction: Restricts or enforces a restriction on learning, speech or association.
reasons.knowledge-duty: Owes accessible communication, public information or creative autonomy to people.
reasons.concentration: Finds against a concentrated communication actor.
reasons.acts-for-person: Lets someone act for, decide with, or hold a role over another person.
reasons.care-continuity: Continuing care or bodily autonomy for the person concerned.
reasons.claim: Opens a protection claim for a person, animal or the commons, restricting nobody by itself.
reasons.animal-order: An order against the person or body responsible for an animal or habitat.
reasons.animal-use: Tests or permits a use that can harm animals.
reasons.custodian-duty: Imposes welfare duties on the custodians of animals.
reasons.animal-coverage: Extends the protected class to an animal or a taxon, which changes whose welfare duties apply.
reasons.office-function: An independent office's collective result or exercise of its function.
reasons.information-demand: Demands information or evidence from others.
reasons.liability: Imposes liability or a duty to cease, restore or pay.
reasons.ceiling: Sets or applies a legal ecological ceiling or precaution that restricts activity.
reasons.science: Records scientific findings, compliance or finality with no individual subject.
reasons.continuity: Preserves the floor, care or restoration while a failure is repaired.
reasons.custody: Confines a person under a conviction.
reasons.delivery: Concludes that something owed reached the person, on an independent witness.
reasons.supplement: Concludes an above-floor supplement, compensation, certificate or restitution for its subject.
reasons.credibility-candidate: Qualifies a proposed credibility finding against a person.
reasons.request: Lets a person make a request, contest or challenge, binding nobody to grant it.
reasons.pause: Interrupts or pauses an authorised activity.
reasons.restraint: Restrains a person or their property.
